findings.summary: The salary parser takes the minimum of every currency-marked amount, so `$80k-$110k USD + $15k signing bonus` becomes $1,250/month and a job whose base salary exceeds a $5,000 threshold is permanently filtered out.
findings.correction: Parse the base salary amount or range separately and exclude amounts identified as bonus, equity, commission, or signing compensation before selecting the salary floor; add a regression test with a currency-valued bonus.
